title: Post-signup display name prompt
description: After first login via magic link, show a 'What should we call you?' screen prompting for display name. Skippable but encouraged. Only shows once (on first auth).

acceptanceCriteria.text: After first login, user sees display name prompt screen
Screen has text input for display name
'Continue' button saves name and redirects to dashboard
'Skip for now' link goes directly to dashboard
Prompt only shows once (tracks in user record or localStorage)
Existing users (already have displayName) skip the prompt
Verify in browser: new user sees prompt after magic link login
